import json, subprocess, sys, math
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')

def run(req):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(req).encode(),capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr.decode()
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())['cases'][0]['events']

def close(a,b,where):
    if abs(a-b) > 1e-7+1e-7*max(abs(a),abs(b)):
        print('MISMATCH', where, a, b); return 1
    return 0

bad=0
# ---- scenario A: route, single everything
base=dict(nodes=2, edges=[[0,1,10]], commodities=[{'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':6,'paths':[[0]]}],
          workers=[[0]], quorum=1, max_lag=0, relax=[1,1], rho=2, mode='route')
ev=[{'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'},
    {'op':'retune','rho':4},{'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'},{'op':'save','name':0},
    {'op':'restore','name':0},{'op':'audit'}]
req={'cases':[dict(base, events=ev)]}
out=run(req)
bad+=close(out[0]['bias'][0],0.0,'A bias')
bad+=close(out[0]['result']['flow'][0][0],6.0,'A flow')
bad+=close(out[0]['result']['potential'][0],-6.12,'A potential')
bad+=close(out[0]['result']['edge_load'][0],6.0,'A load')
assert out[1]['status']=='accepted', out[1]
assert out[2]['status']=='advanced'
bad+=close(out[2]['load'][0],6.0,'A S'); bad+=close(out[2]['ceiling'],0.1,'A h')
bad+=close(out[2]['z'][0],0.1,'A z'); bad+=close(out[2]['dual'][0],0.5,'A u')
bad+=close(out[2]['pressure'][0],1.0,'A t')
assert out[2]['round']==1
bad+=close(out[3]['z'][0],0.1,'A audit z'); bad+=close(out[3]['dual'][0],0.5,'A audit u')
bad+=close(out[3]['age'][0],1,'A age')
# after retune rho=4: u should become 0.5*2/4 = 0.25 ; step blocked (not fresh)
assert out[5]['status']=='waiting', out[5]
bad+=close(out[6]['dual'][0],0.25,'A retuned dual')
assert out[8]['generation']==out[6]['generation']+1, (out[8],out[6])
bad+=close(out[8]['dual'][0],0.25,'A restored dual')
assert out[8]['round']==1
# ---- scenario B: admit
baseB=dict(base, mode='admit')
req={'cases':[dict(baseB, events=[{'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'}])]}
out=run(req)
xstar=1/1.02
bad+=close(out[0]['result']['flow'][0][0],xstar,'B flow')
bad+=close(out[0]['result']['potential'][0],0.0,'B potential')
assert out[2]['status']=='advanced'
bad+=close(out[2]['z'][0],out[2]['load'][0]/10,'B z equals V (below 1)')
bad+=close(out[2]['dual'][0],0.0,'B dual zero')
bad+=close(out[2]['ceiling'],1.0,'B ceiling')
bad+=close(out[2]['pressure'][0],0.0,'B pressure')
# ---- scenario C: two workers, quorum 1, max_lag 0: needs both seen and both fresh
baseC=dict(nodes=2, edges=[[0,1,10]], commodities=[{'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':6,'paths':[[0]]},
                                                     {'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':4,'paths':[[0]]}],
           workers=[[0],[1]], quorum=1, max_lag=0, relax=[1,1], rho=2, mode='route')
ev=[{'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'step'},
    {'op':'issue','id':1,'worker':1},{'op':'step'},{'op':'deliver','id':1},{'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'}]
out=run({'cases':[dict(baseC,events=ev)]})
assert out[2]['status']=='waiting' and out[2]['missing']==[1] and out[2]['fresh']==[0], out[2]
assert out[4]['status']=='waiting' and out[4]['missing']==[] and out[4]['stale']==[0], out[4]
assert out[6]['status']=='advanced', out[6]
assert out[7]['age']==[0,0], out[7]
bad+=close(out[6]['load'][0],10.0,'C load')
# step again without new deliveries: both fresh cleared -> waiting (quorum 1)
out2=run({'cases':[dict(baseC,events=ev+[{'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'}])]})
assert out2[8]['status']=='waiting' and out2[8]['fresh']==[] and out2[8]['stale']==[0,1], out2[8]
# ---- scenario D: superseded / obsolete / duplicate ordering
baseD=dict(baseC, quorum=2, max_lag=12)
ev=[{'op':'issue','id':5,'worker':0},{'op':'issue','id':6,'worker':0},
    {'op':'deliver','id':6},{'op':'deliver','id':5},{'op':'deliver','id':6},
    {'op':'configure','mode':'route','capacity':[],'demand':[],'paths':[]},
    {'op':'deliver','id':5},{'op':'issue','id':7,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':7},
    {'op':'deliver','id':7}]
out=run({'cases':[dict(baseD,events=ev)]})
got=[e['status'] for e in out if e['op']=='deliver']
assert got==['accepted','superseded','duplicate','obsolete','accepted','duplicate'], got
assert [e['generation'] for e in out if e['op'] in ('issue','configure')]==[0,0,1,1], out
# ---- scenario E: withdraw an edge, infeasible proposal, admit fallback
baseE=dict(nodes=2, edges=[[0,1,0]], commodities=[{'source':0,'sink':1,'demand':6,'paths':[[0]]}],
           workers=[[0]], quorum=1, max_lag=0, relax=[1,1], rho=2, mode='route')
out=run({'cases':[dict(baseE,events=[{'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':0},
                                      {'op':'step'},{'op':'audit'},{'op':'configure','mode':'admit','capacity':[[0,5]],'demand':[],'paths':[]},
                                      {'op':'issue','id':1,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':1},{'op':'step'}])]})
assert out[0]['result']=={'status':'infeasible','unroutable':[0]}, out[0]
assert out[1]['status']=='infeasible', out[1]
assert out[2]['status']=='waiting' and out[2]['missing']==[0], out[2]
assert out[3]['z']==[0.0] and out[3]['dual']==[0.0], out[3]
assert out[3]['generation']==1 and out[3]['round']==0
assert out[4]['generation']==2
assert out[5]['result']['status']=='optimal' and out[5]['result']['flow'][0][0]==0.0, out[5]
assert out[6]['status']=='accepted'
assert out[7]['status']=='advanced' and out[7]['ceiling']==1.0, out[7]
# ---- scenario F: all edges withdrawn, controller ceiling conventions
out=run({'cases':[dict(baseE, mode='route', events=[{'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':0}])],
         'x':0} if False else {'cases':[dict(baseE,events=[{'op':'configure','mode':'route','capacity':[],'demand':[],'paths':[]},
                                                            {'op':'issue','id':0,'worker':0},{'op':'deliver','id':0},{'op':'step'}])]})
assert out[1]['result']['status']=='infeasible'
assert out[2]['status']=='infeasible'
assert out[3]['status']=='waiting'
print('scenario failures:', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
